subject: Upcoming Facility Maintenance
body_text: Dear team, we have an important announcement regarding our office facilities. Please take note of the following: this Friday, the office will be closed for routine maintenance work. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and we appreciate your understanding and cooperation. Thank you!
